text:
maria (product): Quick sync — propose we frame Private Deploy roadmap around 'Landing Zones' concept: a graded set of packaging/upgrade paths for customer-managed networking. Want to agree scope and launch gates.

sanjay (eng-platform): +1. What do you mean by 'graded'? three tiers?

maria (product): yes — Minimal (airgap-friendly slim installer), Managed-Relay (operator + optional relay for behind-NAT), and Full-LZ (customer VPC + curated routing primitives + operator APIs).

eva (field): Customers keep asking for zero-ip-change upgrades and predictable cutovers. Minimal installer often breaks that. We should surface IP-preserve mode in design.

luca (eng-infra): IP-preserve implies we can't reassign node egress during upgrade. That's heavy for autoscaling. We can support sticky egress via a relay or by NAT pinning; both have tradeoffs.

jen (sre): Also need observability contract per tier — Full-LZ can emit richer traces, Minimal must have telemetry opt-out and offline-mode logging.

dave (solutions): From the field, customers want a preflight checklist that includes: IP plan, DNS cert handoff, KMS key provisioning. If any of those fail, installer should surface explicit rollback guidance.

maria (product): Agreed. Draft launch gates I'm thinking: 1) Minimal: installer + offline preflight + rollback path; 2) Managed-Relay: operator + relay proxy + staged-rollout docs; 3) Full-LZ: handshakes for VPC peering, egress pinning, and SLA support.

sanjay (eng-platform): Can we split workstreams: Installer UX (minimal), Runtime (relay/operator), and Networking (handshake + IP preservation)? Parallelize but with shared test harness.

luca (eng-infra): I'll own Networking test harness. We need an e2e fixture that simulates NAT, preserved IP, and DNS cutover. Propose a small k8s-in-vm setup for this.

eva (field): We should validate with 3 pilot customers: one that is airgapped, one behind strict NAT, one with customer VPC. I'll map candidates.

jen (sre): For rollout policy, require the following telemetry before GA: error rates < 0.1% on handshake ops, latency SLO for relay < 100ms p95, and deterministic rollback within 10 minutes.

maria (product): Noted. Also need clear upgrade semantics: in-place patch vs operator-driven coordinate-upgrade. Which tiers allow in-place?

sanjay (eng-platform): Minimal: in-place only (no operator). Managed-Relay: operator-coordinated upgrades with fallback to hosted model. Full-LZ: operator + customer handshake required.

dave (solutions): Docs must include a compatibility matrix: customer infra versions, supported CNI, DNS providers, and required ports. Make it a PR checklist for SEs.

ops-bot: <link_to_doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/private-landing-zones/initial-spec> (snapshot v0.1)

maria (product): Action items: 1) luca -> prototype e2e fixture (due 2w) 2) sanjay -> installer UX spec for Minimal (1w) 3) jen -> observability contract draft (1w) 4) eva -> recruit pilots + success criteria (2w) 5) dave -> compatibility matrix skeleton (3d). Anyone object?

sanjay (eng-platform): fine. I'll also add a simple CLI flag `--ip-preserve` to installer prototype so field can try it.

luca (eng-infra): FYI implementation options for pinning: a) NAT pinning via static SNAT ipper node b) sidecar relay to preserve egress c) iptables-based DNAT mapping. I'll prototype b first.

jen (sre): Add security review to gates — KMS/HSM usage and audit logs required for Full-LZ. No GA before Sec approves.

eva (field): Pilot success metric: zero-customer-facing errors during an upgrade window for at least two upgrades. Also measure time-to-restore after simulated failure.

maria (product): OK. We'll target Minimal beta in 6 weeks if we hit the installer spec and two pilots commit. Managed-Relay alpha in 12 weeks. Full-LZ exploratory after that.

dave (solutions): I'll draft the SE playbook for Minimal and hand to marketing for early docs.

maria (product): Decision notes summarized: - Adopt 'Landing Zones' as organizing concept - Three-tier roadmap (Minimal / Managed-Relay / Full-LZ) - Launch gates include preflight, telemetry, rollback semantics, and security signoff - Owners assigned (luca, sanjay, jen, eva, dave)

ops-bot: Reminder set: follow-up sync in 1 week. :calendar:

sanjay (eng-platform): Quick question — do we need to support multi-tenant clusters in Minimal? I'm leaning no, keep Minimal single-tenant to reduce scope.

eva (field): +1 keep Minimal single-tenant. Multi-tenant is a Full-LZ ask.

maria (product): Agreed, Minimal = single-tenant installer. We'll call out multi-tenant in Full-LZ requirements.

jen (sre): I'll start a checklist PR for the telemetry gating. tagging @maria when ready.

maria (product): Thanks all — I'll turn this into a short PR spec and share by EOD. If you see anything missing ping me. :pray:
